sparklineEditData.label: Edit Data
sparklineEditData.description: Change the cells the active cell's sparkline group draws in, and the cells it draws.

sparklineTypeLine.label: Line
sparklineTypeLine.description: Change the selected sparkline groups to line sparklines.

sparklineTypeColumn.label: Column
sparklineTypeColumn.description: Change the selected sparkline groups to column sparklines.

sparklineTypeWinLoss.label: Win/Loss
sparklineTypeWinLoss.description: Change the selected sparkline groups to win/loss sparklines: up for a positive value, down for a negative one.

sparklineShowOptions.label: Show
sparklineShowOptions.description: Choose which points the sparklines highlight.

sparklineHighPointToggle.label: Toggle High Point
sparklineHighPointToggle.description: Highlight the highest point of each sparkline.

sparklineLowPointToggle.label: Toggle Low Point
sparklineLowPointToggle.description: Highlight the lowest point of each sparkline.

sparklineNegativePointsToggle.label: Toggle Negative Points
sparklineNegativePointsToggle.description: Highlight the negative points of each sparkline.

sparklineFirstPointToggle.label: Toggle First Point
sparklineFirstPointToggle.description: Highlight the first point of each sparkline.

sparklineLastPointToggle.label: Toggle Last Point
sparklineLastPointToggle.description: Highlight the last point of each sparkline.

sparklineMarkersToggle.label: Toggle Markers
sparklineMarkersToggle.description: Show a marker on every point of a line sparkline.

sparklineColorSeries.label: Sparkline Color
sparklineColorSeries.description: Color the line or columns of the selected sparkline groups.

sparklineColorNegative.label: Negative Points Color
sparklineColorNegative.description: Color the negative points of the selected sparkline groups.

sparklineColorMarkers.label: Markers Color
sparklineColorMarkers.description: Color the markers of the selected line sparkline groups.

sparklineColorHigh.label: High Point Color
sparklineColorHigh.description: Color the highest point of each sparkline.

sparklineColorLow.label: Low Point Color
sparklineColorLow.description: Color the lowest point of each sparkline.

sparklineColorFirst.label: First Point Color
sparklineColorFirst.description: Color the first point of each sparkline.

sparklineColorLast.label: Last Point Color
sparklineColorLast.description: Color the last point of each sparkline.

sparklineColorAxis.label: Axis Color
sparklineColorAxis.description: Color the horizontal axis of the selected sparkline groups.

sparklineAxisOptions.label: Axis
sparklineAxisOptions.description: Change the axes, the scaling and how empty and hidden cells are drawn.

sparklineAxisToggle.label: Toggle Axis
sparklineAxisToggle.description: Draw a horizontal axis at zero when zero is within the range.

sparklineRightToLeftToggle.label: Toggle Right-to-Left
sparklineRightToLeftToggle.description: Draw the points from right to left.

sparklineSameMinToggle.label: Toggle Same Minimum
sparklineSameMinToggle.description: Scale every sparkline of the group to the group's lowest value.

sparklineSameMaxToggle.label: Toggle Same Maximum
sparklineSameMaxToggle.description: Scale every sparkline of the group to the group's highest value.

sparklineEmptyCellsGap.label: Show Empty Cells as Gaps
sparklineEmptyCellsGap.description: Leave a gap where a cell is empty.

sparklineEmptyCellsZero.label: Show Empty Cells as Zero
sparklineEmptyCellsZero.description: Draw an empty cell as zero.

sparklineEmptyCellsSpan.label: Connect Over Empty Cells
sparklineEmptyCellsSpan.description: Draw the line straight across an empty cell.

sparklineShowHiddenToggle.label: Toggle Hidden Data
sparklineShowHiddenToggle.description: Draw the values of hidden rows and columns.

groupLabels.sparklineAxisOptions: Show Data in Hidden Rows and Columns

sparklineClear.label: Clear Selected Sparklines
sparklineClear.description: Remove the sparklines from the selected cells. The cells' values stay.

sparklineClearGroups.label: Clear Selected Sparkline Groups
sparklineClearGroups.description: Remove every sparkline of the groups the selection touches.
